instruction:
You are a CCTV systems engineer checking a task-owned synthetic SSC-13 coverage, pixel-density, and storage package.

Use only the task-owned synthetic source pack values shown below for numeric grading. External CCTV design and storage tools shape the workflow context only; they are not extra data sources for this instance.

## Scene

- Product: `SSC-13-LH-06`
- Camera plan: `CCTV-13-PLAN-06`
- Scene target list: `TARGET-13-LIST-06`
- Camera data sheet: `CAM-13-DATA-06`
- Recording policy: `REC-13-POL-06`
- Network/power schedule: `NET-13-PWR-06`
- Surveillance memo: `MEMO-13-CCTV-06`

All checks use the same camera plan, target list, camera data, recording policy, network path, PoE load, and fibre handoff.

## Source Values

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| Camera 01 pixels/target width | {{ camera_01_horizontal_pixels }} px / {{ camera_01_target_width_m }} m |
| Camera 02 pixels/target width | {{ camera_02_horizontal_pixels }} px / {{ camera_02_target_width_m }} m |
| Camera 03 pixels/target width | {{ camera_03_horizontal_pixels }} px / {{ camera_03_target_width_m }} m |
| Required PPM | {{ required_ppm }} |
| Covered targets | {{ covered_targets }} of {{ required_targets }} |
| Camera bitrates | {{ camera_01_bitrate_mbps }}, {{ camera_02_bitrate_mbps }}, {{ camera_03_bitrate_mbps }} Mbps |
| Retention and storage overhead | {{ retention_days }} days / {{ storage_overhead_factor }} |
| Network overhead and capacity | {{ network_overhead_factor }} / {{ uplink_capacity_mbps }} Mbps |
| Camera count and PoE | {{ camera_count }} at {{ camera_poe_w }} W plus {{ recorder_aux_poe_w }} W recorder aux |
| PoE budget | {{ poe_budget_w }} W |
| Fibre basis | {{ fibre_length_km }} km at {{ fibre_loss_db_per_km }} dB/km plus {{ connector_loss_db }}, {{ splice_loss_db }}, {{ reserve_loss_db }} dB |
| Fibre budget | {{ fibre_budget_db }} dB |

## Output Format

Write a compact surveillance memo to `/workspace/output.md`. Include a source-boundary statement that this is a task-owned synthetic source pack. Do not claim authority approval, accepted project evidence, software export validity, full standards compliance, executable real source-pack parsing, generated benchmark readiness, or benchmark readiness.

Include a fenced JSON block with exactly these numeric keys:

```json
{
  "camera_01_pixels_per_m": <numeric_value>,
  "camera_02_pixels_per_m": <numeric_value>,
  "camera_03_pixels_per_m": <numeric_value>,
  "minimum_pixels_per_m": <numeric_value>,
  "ppm_margin": <numeric_value>,
  "coverage_match_fraction": <numeric_value>,
  "storage_required_tb": <numeric_value>,
  "network_load_mbps": <numeric_value>,
  "network_headroom_mbps": <numeric_value>,
  "poe_load_w": <numeric_value>,
  "poe_headroom_w": <numeric_value>,
  "fibre_margin_db": <numeric_value>,
  "overall_pass_score": <numeric_value>
}
```

# ABOUTME: Defines the SSC-13 CCTV coverage, pixel-density, and storage template.
# ABOUTME: Pins one task-owned CCTV source pack and expected outputs.

[meta]
name = "cctv-coverage-pixel-storage-package"
description = "SSC-13 CCTV coverage, PPM, storage, network, PoE, and fibre checks"
long_description = "Calculates source-bound CCTV coverage metrics from a deterministic SSC-13 task-owned source pack. The template combines camera coverage, target PPM, recording retention, bandwidth, PoE, and fibre link margin."
discipline = "electrical"
category = "cctv-coverage-storage"
standards = ["CCTV PPM workflow", "video retention workflow", "network bandwidth review", "fibre loss budget"]
tags = ["electrical", "cctv", "coverage", "ppm", "storage", "network", "poe", "fibre", "deterministic"]
tool_mode = "with-tool"

[params.camera_01_horizontal_pixels]
type = "float"
unit = "px"
description = "CAM-13-DATA-06 camera 01 horizontal pixels"
min = 2688.0
max = 2688.0

[params.camera_01_target_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "TARGET-13-LIST-06 camera 01 target width"
min = 18.0
max = 18.0

[params.camera_02_horizontal_pixels]
type = "float"
unit = "px"
description = "CAM-13-DATA-06 camera 02 horizontal pixels"
min = 2688.0
max = 2688.0

[params.camera_02_target_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "TARGET-13-LIST-06 camera 02 target width"
min = 22.0
max = 22.0

[params.camera_03_horizontal_pixels]
type = "float"
unit = "px"
description = "CAM-13-DATA-06 camera 03 horizontal pixels"
min = 2688.0
max = 2688.0

[params.camera_03_target_width_m]
type = "float"
unit = "m"
description = "TARGET-13-LIST-06 camera 03 target width"
min = 16.0
max = 16.0

[params.required_ppm]
type = "float"
description = "MEMO-13-CCTV-06 required minimum pixels per metre"
min = 100.0
max = 100.0

[params.covered_targets]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "TARGET-13-LIST-06 covered target count"
min = 7.0
max = 7.0

[params.required_targets]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "TARGET-13-LIST-06 required target count"
min = 7.0
max = 7.0

[params.camera_01_bitrate_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "REC-13-POL-06 camera 01 bitrate"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.camera_02_bitrate_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "REC-13-POL-06 camera 02 bitrate"
min = 5.0
max = 5.0

[params.camera_03_bitrate_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "REC-13-POL-06 camera 03 bitrate"
min = 8.0
max = 8.0

[params.retention_days]
type = "float"
unit = "days"
description = "REC-13-POL-06 retention days"
min = 30.0
max = 30.0

[params.storage_overhead_factor]
type = "float"
description = "REC-13-POL-06 storage overhead factor"
min = 1.15
max = 1.15

[params.network_overhead_factor]
type = "float"
description = "NET-13-PWR-06 network overhead factor"
min = 1.20
max = 1.20

[params.uplink_capacity_mbps]
type = "float"
unit = "Mbps"
description = "NET-13-PWR-06 uplink capacity"
min = 50.0
max = 50.0

[params.camera_count]
type = "float"
unit = "count"
description = "CCTV-13-PLAN-06 camera count"
min = 3.0
max = 3.0

[params.camera_poe_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "NET-13-PWR-06 PoE per camera"
min = 14.0
max = 14.0

[params.recorder_aux_poe_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "NET-13-PWR-06 recorder auxiliary PoE allowance"
min = 10.0
max = 10.0

[params.poe_budget_w]
type = "float"
unit = "W"
description = "NET-13-PWR-06 PoE budget"
min = 90.0
max = 90.0

[params.fibre_length_km]
type = "float"
unit = "km"
description = "NET-13-PWR-06 fibre length"
min = 0.8
max = 0.8

[params.fibre_loss_db_per_km]
type = "float"
unit = "dB/km"
description = "NET-13-PWR-06 fibre attenuation"
min = 0.35
max = 0.35

[params.connector_loss_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "NET-13-PWR-06 connector loss"
min = 1.0
max = 1.0

[params.splice_loss_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "NET-13-PWR-06 splice loss"
min = 0.3
max = 0.3

[params.reserve_loss_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "NET-13-PWR-06 reserve loss"
min = 1.5
max = 1.5

[params.fibre_budget_db]
type = "float"
unit = "dB"
description = "NET-13-PWR-06 fibre budget"
min = 16.0
max = 16.0

[outputs.camera_01_pixels_per_m]
description = "Camera 01 pixels per metre"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.camera_02_pixels_per_m]
description = "Camera 02 pixels per metre"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.camera_03_pixels_per_m]
description = "Camera 03 pixels per metre"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.minimum_pixels_per_m]
description = "Minimum camera pixels per metre"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.ppm_margin]
description = "Minimum PPM minus required PPM"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.coverage_match_fraction]
description = "Covered targets divided by required targets"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.storage_required_tb]
description = "CCTV storage requirement"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.network_load_mbps]
description = "Network load including overhead"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.network_headroom_mbps]
description = "Uplink capacity minus network load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.poe_load_w]
description = "PoE load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.poe_headroom_w]
description = "PoE budget minus load"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.fibre_margin_db]
description = "Fibre budget minus calculated loss"
tolerance = 0.003

[outputs.overall_pass_score]
description = "1.0 when CCTV, storage, network, PoE, and fibre checks pass"
tolerance = 0.001
